**After:** only `main.org` and `tangles/` stay in `docs/`. Everything else is in `docs/architecture/`. #58 (merged) already moved `load-order.org`, its two SVGs, `why-this-literate.org` and the comparison doc there; this PR adds the rest that appeared on `main` since: `projects-sidebar-layout.org` and `skills/thesis-brain-dump/SKILL.md`.

- `sp-thesis-dump.org` now tangles the skill to `docs/architecture/skills/`; links in `docs/main.org` and the CHANGELOG follow.
- CHANGELOG: a "Docs layout" set.
- Current `main` is merged in; the PR is mergeable.

Not run in Emacs; links checked by reading. `../emacs-include/main.org` (a separate tree) is untouched.
